item.title: Catherine, Princess of Wales, Documents Life With Cancer in BBC Film
item.description: “Cancer does change you,” Catherine, who is in remission, says in a trailer for the film. It will be released this month.

item.title: Pentagon Issued Memo Limiting ‘Social Activities’ With Canadian Military
item.description: The latest salvo in the fraught U.S. relationship with Canada has not affected their vast joint military operation, including the shared airspace command, NORAD.

item.title: Who Is the Mexican Drug Kingpin Known as El Chapo Isidro?
item.description: The kingpin, Fausto Isidro Meza Flores, was captured in a violent operation in Mexico. He was one of the F.B.I.’s 10 most wanted fugitives.

item.title: Victims of Clerical Sexual Abuse Want More Engagement From Pope Leo
item.description: As he toured South America this month, Pope Leo XIV met with 11 victims of clerical sexual abuse. Some want him to engage more meaningfully.

item.title: How Homeowners Are Powering Vietnam’s E-Bike Surge
item.description: The war in Iran has brought on a rapid switch from motorbikes to electric two-wheelers in Vietnam, creating an informal charging economy led by entrepreneurial homeowners.
